To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

patients prefer a patient centric servicescape that offers online appointment booking facility, separate reception for booked patient, provision to meet the preferred doctor, prior detailing of procedure, doctor on call facility, electronic sharing of discharge summaries and online payment facility.

the optimum service levels of HSQ are: online appointment booking facility, provision to review and cancel appointment; separate reception for booked patient; doctor on call to room of stay; prior detailing of procedure; online payment facility; electronic sharing of summary; doctor of choice; and separate waiting area for booked patients.
patients prefer to be treated in a healthcare servicescape that is patient centric, with a separate waiting area for booked appointments and online appointment facility.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the most preferred service levels in the HSQ dimensions, and their effect in the service journey.
the design and development of a healthcare servicescape, which is patient centric.
the development and testing of a methodology for re-designing a patient centric servicescape in healthcare.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Taguchi method can be effectively applied to identify the optimum factor levels for HSQ and the service journey.
Taguchi experiment is a useful tool in the service sector.

this study has provided insights into the factors affecting HSQ and has provided a methodology for service redesign in healthcare servicescapes, which is an area that is under researched in the literature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Taguchi approach is useful for re design of service settings.
the service journey of a patient has a significant effect on HSQ.

the HSQ is affected by the service journey of patients and not just the processes in a particular phase.
the Taguchi approach can be used to design servicescapes that meet the expectations of customers.
a robust approach like Taguchi experiment is useful for re designing healthcare servicescapes.
